issues.what: Explanation incorrectly states that node.kubernetes.io/not-ready is applied 'when the node loses connectivity'. Connectivity loss specifically triggers node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoExecute, not the not-ready taint. The not-ready taint is applied when the node condition becomes NotReady for reasons such as kubelet failures or failed health checks, but NOT specifically for network connectivity loss.
issues.correction: Change '(e.g., node.kubernetes.io/not-ready when the node loses connectivity)' to '(e.g., node.kubernetes.io/not-ready when the node becomes NotReady due to kubelet issues or health check failures — note that connectivity loss specifically triggers node.kubernetes.io/unreachable instead)'
